rows.text: In the asteroid belt of Apex Segmentum, there wanders a silicon-based lifeform known as the drifter fish. For the most part, they move by drifting, slow as space junk, and were once ranked in the top five of the "Least Dangerous Intellitrons." That is, until the Second Emperor's War, when people discovered that their fin-like tails actually concealed high-energy thrusters capable of reaching one-tenth the speed of light in just thirty seconds at full power. In the end, the Marketing Development Department paid the price of the entire Third Fleet to "exterminate" the drifter fish. However, in the Solar Sailboat Competition held in 2120 AE, the IPC representative Hekas Iron-Eye took first place using four drifter fish as propulsion, declaring the domestication of the species complete.
